args.query: SELECT s.store_id, s.name, c.customer_id FROM stores s LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.store_id=s.store_id WHERE s.name ILIKE '%rural%cycle%'

SELECT l.sku, sum(l.order_qty) q, count(*) n, min(o.order_date), max(o.order_date) FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE trim(lower(name))='rural cycle emporium') AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT upper(trim(l.sku)) sku, sum(l.order_qty) q, count(distinct o.customer_id) FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id=c.store_id WHERE lower(s.name) LIKE '%rural cycle%' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND upper(trim(l.sku)) LIKE 'BK%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT o.status, o.order_date, l.order_qty FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.store_id='928' AND upper(trim(l.sku)) IN ('BK-M68B-38','BK-M68S-46') ORDER BY 2
SELECT product_number, name, make_flag FROM products WHERE upper(trim(product_number))='BK-M68B-38'

SELECT 'ip' src, product_number, list_price, null::date sd, null::date ed FROM item_prices WHERE upper(trim(product_number))='BK-M68B-38' UNION ALL SELECT 'h', product_number, list_price, start_date::date, end_date::date FROM list_price_history WHERE upper(trim(product_number))='BK-M68B-38'

SELECT work_order_id, part_no, order_qty, stocked_qty, scrapped_qty, start_date, end_date FROM work_orders WHERE upper(trim(part_no))='BK-M68B-38' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01'
SELECT sum(order_qty), sum(stocked_qty), sum(scrapped_qty), count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE upper(trim(part_no))='BK-M68B-38' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01'

WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT component_number, 1 lvl FROM bom WHERE upper(trim(assembly_number))='BK-M68B-38' AND end_date IS NULL UNION SELECT b.component_number, t.lvl+1 FROM bom b JOIN t ON upper(trim(b.assembly_number))=upper(trim(t.component_number)) WHERE b.end_date IS NULL) SELECT DISTINCT t.component_number, p.make_flag FROM t LEFT JOIN products p ON upper(trim(p.product_number))=upper(trim(t.component_number))
SELECT count(*), count(end_date), max(end_date), min(start_date) FROM bom
SELECT part_ref, vendor_id, average_lead_time FROM vendor_items
